entries.reason: included as a bonus type because the manual player build route places no rolling stock on the measured platform, so the derivation no longer counts it player-buildable: measured 2026-08-16 at 2.1.11 (PR #248), a can_place_entity build_check_type.manual sweep of all 4350 non-empty-space tiles of lab-transfer-fixture-v1 returned 0 placeable for infinity-cargo-wagon — whose own surface_conditions are EMPTY — alongside 0 for straight-rail, cargo-wagon and locomotive, with gate 592/4350 and solar-panel 23/4350 as positive controls in the same sweep. build_check_type.manual is the ONLY route that sweep measured: the construction-bot revival routes (reviving a ghost, building a blueprint) are UNMEASURED here, so this entry claims nothing about them. Rolling stock is built on rail and every rail type at this pin fails gravity >= 1 on the platform vector, but the residual cause beyond that was NOT isolated. The fixture keeps the cell because script placement does create the subject — the same measurement placed straight-rails and a cargo-wagon through surface.create_entity, entity.train resolved on the wagon and train.manual_mode read true — and placement-rules.json seats this wagon on the five-rail segment straight-rail already carries

included as a bonus type because infinity-cargo-wagon needs rail under it to exist at all, so the fixture places a rail segment either way; the surface-conditions derivation excludes straight-rail (gravity >= 1 but the platform measures 0) and create_entity places it anyway on a surface carrying ignore_surface_conditions, which makes the rail a payload-carried type the export scanner routes through its else branch
